lru_cache.py

A thread-safe LRU cache with per-entry TTL (time-to-live) expiry.

Features
--------
- Thread-safe via a re-entrant lock (RLock) so re-entrant calls
  (e.g., a get() that triggers a cleanup) don't deadlock.
- LRU eviction: least-recently-used entries are evicted first when
  the cache exceeds its maximum size.
- Per-entry TTL: each entry may have its own TTL; entries older than
  their TTL are treated as missing and lazily purged.
- Type hints throughout, generic over key/value types.
- Optional statistics: hits, misses, evictions, expiries.

Example
-------
>>> cache = LRUCache[str, int](maxsize=2, default_ttl=60)
>>> cache.put("a", 1)
>>> cache.get("a")
1
>>> cache.get("missing") is None
True
"""
